title: Detect a loop with slow and fast pointers
invariant: After k rounds, slow has taken k steps and fast has taken 2k. If they're ever equal after moving, the walk loops.

frames.explanation: Both start at 3. slow takes one step and fast takes two: slow = 0, fast = 1. Not equal yet.
slow takes one step and fast takes two: slow = 1, fast = 5. Not equal yet.
slow takes one step and fast takes two: slow = 2, fast = 7. Not equal yet.
slow takes one step and fast takes two: slow = 5, fast = 1. Not equal yet.
slow takes one step and fast takes two: slow = 6, fast = 5. Not equal yet.
slow takes one step and fast takes two: slow = 7, fast = 7.
slow and fast are both at 7. fast can only catch slow by lapping it inside a loop, so the walk has a loop. Only two numbers were stored.
Both start at 0. slow takes one step and fast takes two: slow = 1, fast = 2. Not equal yet.
slow takes one step and fast takes two: slow = 2, fast = 6. Not equal yet.
slow takes one step and fast takes two: slow = 5, fast = 0. Not equal yet.
slow takes one step and fast takes two: slow = 6, fast = 2. Not equal yet.
slow takes one step and fast takes two: slow = 7, fast = 6. Not equal yet.
slow takes one step and fast takes two: slow = 0, fast = 0.
slow and fast are both at 0. fast can only catch slow by lapping it inside a loop, so the walk has a loop. Only two numbers were stored.
